title: Upcoming page: future steps box with zones
description: Add a separate 'Future Steps' section at the top of Settings → Task Log. Supports (ZONE) targeting, multi-line input, drag-to-reorder, copy content, and delete per item. Displayed separately from the task list below.

title: Family needs: multi-seed linked selection
description: The Linked Seed field on Add Yearly Need should allow selecting multiple seeds, not just one. When you have several carrot varieties, any of them should satisfy the need.

title: Redesign upcoming page as live task tracker
description: Replace version-based roadmap with a request-driven task log stored in platform_tasks.json. Status cycles empty→done→error→trigger_ai; Claude logs every platform request here automatically and prioritises trigger_ai tasks on session start.

title: App icon on login page
description: Add the Rooted app icon (icon-192.png) above the Sign In heading on the auth login page. Centred with rounded corners and soft shadow.

title: Garden bed drag-to-reorder within a garden
description: Add a drag handle to each bed row so beds can be reordered per garden. Order saved via AJAX to items.sort_order and persists across page loads.

title: Action log reminder INSERT non-fatal
description: Wrap the reminder INSERT in addAction() with try/catch so a reminder schema failure can never crash the whole log request. Log entry always saves regardless.

title: Garden bed reordering + action log fix
description: Beds within a garden can be drag-reordered (sort_order on items). Action log reminder INSERT wrapped in try/catch — log always saves even if reminder fails.
